On Isla Grande, a journey through Colombia's cities continues by the Caribbean Sea. The island is part of the Rosario Islands archipelago, reached by boat from Cartagena. You can spend the day swimming, relaxing in the shade of tropical vegetation and enjoying lunch with a sea view.

San Pedro de Majagua, located on the island, welcomes visitors for day trips. Ada Tours itineraries here may include a shared speedboat and private transfers between the hotel and the pier. The services included depend on the chosen itinerary.

Some itineraries use the name Majagua for the island excursion itself. Geographically, San Pedro de Majagua is on Isla Grande, one of the Rosario Islands.

Isla Perro is known for a snorkeling spot beside a sunken vessel. Corals and fish can be seen around the wreck, making this stop an opportunity to discover marine life. The island lies in the San Blas area, surrounded by Caribbean beaches and clear water.

A visit to Isla Perro can also include time relaxing on the shore and walking around the island. A yacht itinerary lets you see it from the sea, while exploring the shallows reveals their details. The natural island scenery contrasts with the remains of the vessel underwater, now the setting for a distinct underwater scene.
